# New upgrade. Kuailu Smart Office AI CRM leads the sales management 2.0 era!

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Published: 2026-05-07
- Original link: [https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202605/07/WS69fbfb55a310942cc49aafe6.html](https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202605/07/WS69fbfb55a310942cc49aafe6.html]

## Text
It's been a long time since CRM was sold. Industry research shows that 68 per cent of sales data is still outside the CRM, and that sales personnel spend an average of two hours per day on manual entry and filing, with the limitations of the traditional CRM process gradually emerging.

When generating AI steps to implement the closed loop, AI Agent is reshaping the software logic. Kuailu, as an intelligent business pioneer, has set out to re-launch Kuailu AI CRM, re-enacting it with an AI original structure, embedding it deep into the acquisition, nurturing-business follow-up-contracting-recovering business closed loops, proactive insight, research and execution, upgrading it from an additional tool to an enterprise-wide smart business hub, and bringing CRM back to its full growth dimension!

Not just system tools, but growth partners.

At present, most CRMs have built off-posted AIs, which serve only to optimize points of system interaction, knowledge base, etc., and do not fundamentally meet the growth objectives of enterprises. The AI original CRM is based on full process data, using large model intelligence analysis and reasoning to enable the CRM to upgrade completely from a "flow drive" to a "insight drive"!

Kuailu AI CRM, as an AI primary product, uses AI to build an enterprise-wide data intelligence hub with a three-tiered self-study smart architecture at the bottom: AI Data Centre + AI Smart Centre + AI Core Business Engine, real-time insight into sales dynamics from a global business perspective, smart research on business risks, auto-generated warfare strategies, smart insights, smart decision-making, smart execution, full backdisclosure!

Policymakers: Overview operations are conducted and business is controlled dynamically

Data are the central moat of the enterprise, and most CRM data are currently fragmented and logically less relevant, unable to record real operations, and less able to guide business decisions, often too much data for decision makers and not how to use it.

Kuailu AI CRM carries the AI Smart Diagnosis Engine, the Real-Time Performance Disk, the Multi-dimensional Operators Board, and creates a driver's cockpit with clear indicators of performance progress, client structure, business transformation rate, follow-up activity, customer loss warning. At the same time, business-wide visualization monitoring, risk early warning, and smart performance trend predictions leave behind a back-to-back, blind operation.

Executor: AI model to plan, direction

Traditional CRM marketing schemes are more dependent on the “empirical sense” of the sales staff and are based on personal judgement and spreadsheets, which are not only time-consuming and labour-intensive but also of low accuracy. It is unable to provide clear operational guidance for sales.

Kuailu AI CRM automatically generates an exclusive daily personalized follow-up list using the AI model, based on real master data of the enterprise, client intent phase, historical follow-up records, and the probability of a transaction.

The plan is fully aligned with the real business scene, with intelligent individual work tempo and client current status, with clear planning for daily follow-up of clients, key actions, nodal targets, complete elimination of blind follow-up, ineffective busy work, and full focus of sales on high-value trade moves.

AI Smart Toolbox, full process free production Power

The Kuailu AI CRM not only solidifies the four basic modules of clues, customers, business opportunities, and orders, but also penetrates the full range of AI ' s operations, building an AI smart toolbox to be used in 9 open boxes, covering the recipients, follow-up, offer, collaborate and manage the entire business.

AI generates quotations as an example:

KuailuAI CRM generated an offer for one minute and the profit was real-time visible and no longer due.

Step 1: Upload the custom quote template, enter the discount to automatically calculate the amount, avoid manual accounting errors, and make the template smart accounting:

Step 2: System Depth Linking CRM Business Information, Business One Generation, No Manual Filling, One Key Draw Data Automatically Generates Standard, Professional quotes.

Step 3: The resulting quotations support online downloading, direct printing, harmonization of enterprise external export formats, and efficient and standardized quotation processes.

Take the example of AI client insight:

- AI Insight Expert: 10 seconds to generate full-dimensional client reports, double the efficiency of ice break-ups, and new people can change specialists in seconds.
- Step 1: Enter the name of the client to capture the client information and generate the full-dimensional support information before the visit
- Step 2: Cover open business information, AI analysis of client groups, sales products, distribution channels, distribution patterns and competitors
- Step 3: Synchronize the pains of the industry and provide three different first-time communications topics to help with efficient visits.

Using AI as an engine, win-wins digital value.

From a single data tool to self-decision-making, self-implementation of the AI growth engine, CRM is truly moving from a cumbersome tool to a growth partner, with greater commercial value. Kuailu Smart Office redefines the value of marketing tools for AI CRM, transforms the data in circulation into an AI-era business insight, and helps businesses to improve their business!
